resolution: InstantMesh ran the multiview diffusion fine but OOM'd at FlexiCubes mesh extraction: a single ~15GB GPU alloc (index_select over the grid_res=128 grid) vs the 3060's 12GB. Explained RAM offload can't fix it (it's a tensor op, not offloadable weights) and 12<15 so even full VRAM is short. Fix = lower the extraction grid_res (memory ~ cube of it): edit configs/instant-mesh-large.yaml grid_res 128->64 (safe, ~2GB; 96 for more detail). Gave the user the manual edit + PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, and baked a sed (128->64 on both configs) into setup-instantmesh.sh so it's 12GB-friendly OOTB. Noted base config is identical to large (same grid_res/dims) so it wouldn't have helped. Committed.
